In recent years, more people have been moving out to the countryside to live a more self-sustaining life. But going fully off-grid isn’t easy, and often turns into a full-time job. Today we head out to Doc’s 40-acre setup—a kind of off-grid 2.0. He’s connected to the world, but with a flip of a switch and a close of the gate, he’s good on his own for up to two years. Join us as we show you around this sweet setup in rural Georgia.
